title: Linux Factory Reset
language.session: Language changed for this session; the preference could not be saved.
main.notice: Release candidate. Prepare recovery data, preview changes, then explicitly confirm restoration.
status.download: Ubuntu / Debian / Fedora; progress and speed
status.check: Check layout, tools, boot conditions and space
error.dialog: Cannot open a desktop dialog. Run linux-factory-reset --help in a terminal.
error.gui_root: Open the interface as a regular desktop user. Administrator access is requested when needed.
operation.wait: Waiting for authorization or for the operation to start.
operation.title: Processing recovery data
operation.lookup: Reading the official image catalog (up to 90 seconds per request)
operation.failed: The operation did not complete. Copy the actual error below when reporting it:
operation.auth_hint: For authorization errors, check the desktop authentication agent or use sudo linux-factory-reset in a terminal.
operation.preview:
Read-only preview; no restoration performed.
*deleting marks deletions; other lines show additions or changes. Unchanged files are omitted.
download.title: Download official system image
download.connecting: Connecting to the official source. Cancel stops the download.
download.notice: Download installer ISO images and checksums from official sources. Automatic ISO restoration is not implemented; use Prepare recovery for automatic restoration.
download.arch: Host architecture: {arch}. Select the target architecture. ARM64 includes generic UEFI computers, servers and VMs.
download.directory: Choose a download folder; a second recovery disk is not required
prepare.source: Choose a recovery source. Ordinary preparation does not require a custom URL or a manually entered checksum.
prepare.local: Select a local installed-system image (IMG / RAW / QCOW2)
prepare.auto: Automatically download and verify official recovery data
prepare.storage:
Choose a folder on a separate mounted ext4 recovery volume. A normal folder on the system volume is not sufficient.
For a VM, first add, format and mount another disk. This step only prepares data. Use a trusted clean installed-system image; automatic installer-ISO deployment is not implemented.
prepare.download_folder: Choose temporary download storage. Progress and speed are shown; temporary downloads are cleaned after import. This prepares data without restoring the system.
restore.warning:
This reboots and deletes ALL old users, personal files, extra software and configuration.
Keep the recovery disk connected and use stable power. Physical-hardware acceptance is incomplete for this candidate.

Type the exact ASCII confirmation token below:
{token}
diagnose.prompt:
Choose a NEW JSON filename; existing files are never overwritten.
Includes versions, system, architecture, filesystem types, preparation state and tool availability.
Excludes usernames, personal paths, disk UUIDs, image URLs and logs. Nothing is uploaded.
diagnose.saved:
Diagnostic report saved locally; nothing uploaded.
File: {path}
advanced.notice: Administrator options; not required for ordinary preparation.
advanced.custom: Import an administrator profile (URL and independent checksum)
advanced.url: HTTPS URL of the administrator-published recovery profile
advanced.hash: SHA-256 obtained through an independent trusted channel
prepared.missing: Select and prepare a recovery image before previewing changes. No recovery data is ready.
prepared.ready: Recovery data is prepared; changes can be previewed
prepared.invalid: Recovery metadata cannot be read. Prepare the image again.
source.generic: Uses an official base/server image without a desktop, matching the current version and verified against official HTTPS checksums. Creates a new administrator and disables cloud account initialization. It does not recreate the original desktop.
source.native: Automatically selects an official Ubuntu source and verifies its signature; no URL entry required
source.unavailable: No verified built-in automatic source is available for this device. Select a local IMG/RAW image; no custom server is required.
stage.checking: Checking the environment and recovery volume
stage.inspecting: Inspecting image partitions and system content
stage.normalizing: Preparing the initial system and first-user setup
stage.initramfs: Building the offline recovery boot environment
stage.arming: Scheduling restoration on the next boot
check.title: Preparation checks (read-only)
check.ready: Preparation checks passed; image content and actual boot writes still require later verification.
check.blocked: Preparation checks did not pass. Resolve the blockers and unknown items below.
check.note: Read-only checks do not download images, create recovery folders, schedule resets or change firmware. Space is an initial estimate excluding image-import and expanded staging; the actual image is checked later.
check.retry: If access is denied, retry read-only with sudo linux-factory-reset check --storage /mnt/recovery.
check.pending_block: A reset is already scheduled. Cancel it before preparing new recovery data.
check.tools_ok: Tools found; actual execution is verified in later steps
check.secure_unknown: State is missing, unreadable or malformed; it is unknown and is not treated as disabled
check.secure_enabled: Secure Boot is enabled. This rescue version requires it already disabled; firmware settings are never changed automatically.
check.efi_mount_unknown: Cannot read the UEFI-variable mount state
check.efi_readonly: The UEFI-variable filesystem is mounted read-only
check.efi_permission: No write access to the UEFI-variable directory; retry the read-only check as administrator
check.bootorder: Cannot read the original UEFI BootOrder
check.efi_ok: Mount is writable and BootOrder readable. No variable was written; remaining firmware capacity is not guaranteed.
check.no_uefi: UEFI is not in use; layout checks determine platform support
check.root_low: Less than 512 MiB free on the system volume; insufficient working space for recovery boot preparation
check.boot_low: Less than 64 MiB free on the boot volume
check.boot_unknown: Cannot confirm a separate boot volume; root free space is not substituted
check.storage: Recovery volume and initial space estimate
check.storage_unselected: No recovery volume selected; add --storage to check it
check.storage_choose: Choose a directory on a mounted recovery volume
check.storage_identity: Resolve system and boot volume identity first
check.space_overflow: Space estimate overflow; capacity cannot be confirmed
check.storage_low: Recovery volume has {available} MiB free; initial estimate requires {required} MiB. Free space or choose another volume.
check.storage_ok: {available} MiB free; initially reserve {required} MiB plus image-import staging space
check.root_kind: A plain ext4 root partition is required; Btrfs and separate subvolumes are unsupported
check.root_uuid: Root partition has no usable UUID
check.root_type: Root must be a regular partition, without LVM, encryption or RAID
check.boot_kind: A separate mounted FAT boot partition is required
check.boot_uuid: Boot partition has no usable UUID
check.boot_type: Boot must be a regular partition
cli.language: All commands accept --language en|zh|hi|es|ar|auto; language can also be changed in the GUI.
cli.proxy: Preparation optionally accepts --proxy http://127.0.0.1:PORT or socks5h://127.0.0.1:PORT.
cli.erase: Actual restoration runs offline and removes ALL old personal users and data.
cli.no_profile: No factory profile prepared. No reset performed.
cli.invalid_state: Recovery metadata is unreadable or invalid. No reset performed. Run linux-factory-reset diagnose to collect a local report.
download.cancelled: Download cancelled; no reset was scheduled.
error.iso: An installer ISO cannot directly replace the system. Automatic ISO installation is not implemented; select a complete installed-system IMG/RAW image.
error.image_type: Select IMG, RAW, IMG.XZ, RAW.XZ, QCOW2 or a project recovery profile; do not select a disk device.
recovery.prepared: Recovery data prepared. No reset has been performed.
recovery.cancelled: Pending reset cancelled. System files were not restored.
recovery.armed: Offline restoration is scheduled. Cancel before reboot with sudo linux-factory-reset cancel.
error.storage_root: The selected folder is on the system or boot volume. Use another mounted ext4 recovery volume. For a VM, first add, format and mount another disk. No system change or reset was scheduled.
error.storage_ext4: The location is not on an ext4 recovery volume. Select another mounted ext4 volume; disks are never formatted automatically.
error.storage_readonly: The recovery volume is read-only. Mount it writable and retry.
error.shared_esp: Shared/OEM EFI partition is unsupported; recovery will not delete another OS or vendor's boot files
error.grub: Target must use its distribution's standard GRUB + EFI vendor-directory layout
